mechanism: Posaconazole is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase primaquine metabolism through hepatic enzyme inhibition, potentially altering antimalarial efficacy and increasing risk of primaquine-related adverse effects including hemolytic anemia in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis and primaquine efficacy; consider G6PD screening if not already performed; use caution and monitor CBC during concurrent therapy.
